caption: Figure 3a Orography Factor O for hills and ridges | 1.30 Orography
description: The drawing is a line chart titled Figure 3a Orography Factor O for hills and ridges. The vertical axis, labelled Orography Factor O, runs from 1.00 to 1.40 in steps of 0.05. The horizontal axis, labelled X/Ld on the right-hand side and X/Lu on the left-hand side, runs from -1 to 1.5. Three bell-shaped curves peak at 0: the uppermost, labelled Steep slope < 1/3.3, peaks at 1.35; the middle, labelled Moderate slope = 1/5, peaks at 1.20; the lower, labelled Shallow slope ≤ 1/10, peaks at 1.10. All three begin near 1.00 at -1 and fall back toward 1.00 by 1.5. A grey inset in the upper right shows a cross-section of a hill with a rectangular building at its foot, divided into Lu and Ld, with horizontal dimensions -X and +X above it. A vertical dimension z rises from the left flat ground line to the crest, with a horizontal line at 0.5z marking the lower edge of a shaded band at the top, whose width is dimensioned 0.5Ld; text points to it reading Orography significant in shaded area.
